verdict.line: You win by chaining short, violent trades that kill the fight before his sustain turns on; you lose if you chase a baited-low Mundo into a drawn-out trade and let Masochism and his passive regen flip it.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo has zero hard CC and no disengage — his only defensive tool is W (Burning Agony), which drains his own health to cut disable duration. That means Kled's hit-and-run kit (Q yank, double-dash E, W attack-speed burst) can land, deal its damage, and leave before his passive (Adrenaline Rush) or his missing-health AD steroid (E, Masochism) ever come online. The data backs this directly: Kled holds both lane advantage and solo-kill advantage here (53.8% WR, 78 games), even though the overall shape reads even.

theirWindow.when: Mundo is already low and standing still
theirWindow.what: His E (Masochism) scales AD off missing health, and his passive regenerates a chunk of max HP every second — a 'low' Mundo who holds the fight can burst you back and heal through it. Either commit a full kill with real damage/CC to deny the regen tick, or disengage entirely; don't half-trade into him.

yourWindow.when: you're mounted with Skaarl at decent HP
yourWindow.what: Land Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) to yank him in, follow with E (Jousting) to close, weave W (Violent Tendencies) for the attack-speed burst, then recast E to dash back through him for a second hit. This whole sequence should resolve before his sustain matters.

start.why: Dominant start at 58% WR over 81 games — the lane is a sustained physical trading war, and the extra AD/sustain from Blade wins short all-ins before Mundo's passive regen matters.

boots.why: 54% WR over 50 games. Mundo has no hard CC to dodge with Mercury's Treads — his damage is autos plus a missing-health AD steroid (E), both physical, which Steelcaps flat-out reduces.

core.why: Max-health stacking powers your dash-heavy trade pattern and the wave clear/poke damage from E and autos.
Highest-WR follow-up in the data (66.7% over 6 games on this path) — keeps your short-trade burst scaling as the lane extends.
Grievous Wounds directly shuts down Mundo's passive (Adrenaline Rush) and R (Sadism) healing — the exact tools that let him win a drawn-out fight.

situational.when: he's abusing passive regen to reset trades before your core items complete
the game goes long and you need armor shred to keep killing through his stacked resistances
you're ahead and want more max-health scaling for extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage/healing rewards exactly the repeated-hit trade pattern Kled runs (Q yank, double E dash, W-boosted autos) and gives you the sustain edge to outlast Mundo's own regen in a skirmish.

summoners.why: 87.9% pick rate at 58.6% WR. Ignite's Grievous Wounds is what makes burst actually stick on a champion whose entire identity is healing through damage via passive regen and R.

playing.title: Run the full mounted combo
playing.detail: Q hook to yank him in, E dash to close, weave W's attack-speed window, then recast E to dash back out through him for a second hit.

playing.title: Don't finish a baited-low Mundo
playing.detail: His E (Masochism) scales AD off missing health and his passive heals a % of max HP every second — committing half a trade into a low Mundo can get you burst back.

playing.title: Watch for his W cutting your yank
playing.detail: Burning Agony reduces disable duration, which shortens the shackle on your Q before it triggers the bonus damage and yank.

playing.title: Stop soaking his poke
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver (4s cooldown, 975 range) scales off your max health — as you stack Titanic Hydra and HP items, each poke hits harder, so close the gap instead of eating it.

playing.title: Use Ignite to seal kills
playing.detail: Both his passive and R heal him back from near-death; Grievous Wounds from Ignite (and later Mortal Reminder) is what actually lets a burst kill stay a kill.

playing.title: Save R for cross-map picks
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! has 3500 range and he has no CC or disengage to escape it — use it to collapse on him anywhere, not just as a lane engage.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown window
playing.detail: After Masochism's AD steroid falls off, there's a short stretch before its 7s cooldown refreshes where his damage output drops — that's your safest window to force an extended trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 53.8% head-to-head figure are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning for why the matchup breaks that way is my own read, not OP.GG's.
